title: Welcome to Valley Station Church of God
message: We welcome you to Valley Station Church of God, where faith, family, and fellowship come together. Join us as we worship Jesus Christ and grow together in His Word!

title: Christmas is Coming
message:
🎄 CHRISTMAS IS COMING! 🎄

Come celebrate the joy of Christmas with us at Valley Station Church of God!

Watch for our upcoming Christmas programs, special services, and celebrations as we honor the birth of our Savior, Jesus Christ!

❤️ Jesus Is the Reason for the Season!
